brief: When a user submits the settings form, the Save button should show that work is in progress until the request finishes: a spinner replaces the label, the button keeps its width, and it can't be pressed again. Screen readers should hear that it's busy. How should the design system provide this?

recordPatterns.reason: one boolean-style state prop on Button

source: New case. ADR-009 q1 (same role, same interaction model) + ADR-025 state kinds
notes: Not historical: no reference ADR. Locked by the developer before the first run.
